Field note · 5 min

Small decisions, durable systems

Systems age through hundreds of small choices. Recording those choices keeps later work consistent without freezing it in place.

Write down the why

A short rationale lets a future maintainer distinguish a deliberate constraint from an implementation accident.

Review with evidence

Use deterministic fixtures and narrow tests to show what a decision protects.
